samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>detects pulses in data_in and outputs a 1-cycle wide data_out signal when a pulse ends.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">clock</input>
        <input id="rst_n">reset (active low)</input>
        <input id="data_in">one-bit input signal</input>
        <output id="data_out">output signal indicating a detected pulse</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>TODO</implementation>
</module>
